description: Speculative verification reuses a mask after the filter state advances.
trigger: A filtered job accepts a draft token and proceeds to another sample in the same main-model logit batch.
expected_behavior: Prepare constraints for the newly advanced grammar state before sampling the next position.
actual_behavior: prepare_logit_mask runs once before the inner sampling loop. receive_sample advances filters, but subsequent receive_logits calls use the same device_logit_mask. A token legal only in the preceding state can therefore remain selectable.

verification.description: A two-state model with allowed sets {0} then {1} demonstrated that a frozen first mask permits a second 0 despite the advanced grammar.
verification.limits: Not a Formatron or speculative-decoding execution. The direct receive_sample caller found is iterate_gen; ordinary one-sample iterations do not exercise this stale-within-batch case.

introductions.rationale: New code in310; source/scalar observation accepted for ancestor retrieval only, not repository runtime confirmation.
